description: Deterministic Hallucination Diff API: Fast first filter to catch unsupported numbers, dates, and names in LLM answers vs RAG sources. (Endpoint: POST /v1/hallucination-diff)

answer.description: Generated LLM answer to verify against source documents.
answer.example: Tinplate processes requests in 3 ms with 99.9% uptime and was founded in 2026 in Budapest.

sources.description: Grounding source passages or RAG chunks.
example: Tinplate is an edge API platform founded in 2026 in Budapest with latency typically under 5 ms in deterministic mode.

strictness.description: Threshold profile for classifying claims as supported, partial, or unsupported.

use_ai_judge.description: Enable optional Cloudflare Workers AI second-pass semantic grounding judge (default false; paid plans only). When true, up to 4,000 chars of sources and 1,500 chars of answer are sent over Cloudflare's internal binding to @cf/ibm-granite/granite-4.0-h-micro (adds ~150-400 ms under Cloudflare platform terms).

name: tinplate_hallucination_diff
